mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production signals improving manufacturing activity and economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 115 during early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1000 thousand units, it indicates a strengthening housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPI) rises while the federal funds rate remains stable or falls, it indicates a non-reactive monetary policy that is perceived as accommodative, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or falling, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales exceed 380,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 380000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
